caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with a rectangular form and four legs, each shaped like a dark wooden ball. The chest is designed with three main rows of drawers, each row containing two drawers side by side except for the middle section of the second row, which features a solid panel with vertical rectangles. The drawers are detailed with geometric patterns made up of rectangles and trapezoids in varying shades of brown, mimicking wood grain, and some drawers display an octagonal motif. Each drawer has an ornate, brass-colored keyhole plate and pull handle. Vertical, spindle-shaped wooden columns separate the drawers, and there is a decorative border featuring a triangular pattern immediately beneath the flat top surface. The sides of the chest show rectangular wooden paneling. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the drawing is rendered in tones of brown, beige, and black, with some subtle shading to indicate depth and dimension.
title: Chest of Drawers
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
